# Python IDE {.unnumbered}

```{=html}

<div class="py3grid">
  <div id="editor" class="panel">
    <header id="editor-label">Python editor</header>
    <div class="body">
<p id="editor-help">Press Shift+Enter to run your code. Press Escape to move to the output controls.</p>
<textarea
  id="code"
  aria-labelledby="editor-label"
  aria-describedby="editor-help"
  class="editor-text"
  placeholder="# Write Python code here..."
  spellcheck="false"
  autocorrect="off"
  autocapitalize="off"
  autocomplete="off"
>
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 2*np.pi, 100)
plt.plot(x, np.sin(x), label='sin(x)')
plt.plot(x, np.cos(x), label='cos(x)')
plt.legend()
plt.title('Trigonometric Functions')
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
</textarea>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="output" class="panel">
    <header>
      <span>Output</span>
      <div class="toolbar">
        <button id="runBtn" class="btn" disabled>▶ Run</button>
        <button id="clearBtn" class="btn">Clear</button>
        <span id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading...</span>
      </div>
    </header>
    <div class="body">
      <div id="terminal" role="log" aria-label="Python output" aria-live="polite" tabindex="0"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
